notes: Two hundred placings, with a written paragraph for the top twenty-five. Cites a 1996 edition eleven times by rank; no copy of that edition has been found.

name: 2004 RSPWF 200 and Year Ends

date.source: The post's own date on rec.sport.pro-wrestling.fantasy, 19 January 2005; the poll it carries ranks the 2004 calendar year.

notes: Two hundred and one placings — the last three tied at #199 — followed by the community's whole slate of year-end awards, from Federation of the Year through an out-of-character Best Handler ballot. Its own compiler counts forty-odd ballots and says so.
